title: Canada’s Spirit Rises and Falls With Its Olympic Hockey Teams
summary: Canadians jammed bars that opened at dawn across the nation on Sunday but the United States dealt the team, and the country, a devastating blow in overtime.

title: Syria moves out last residents of ISIL-linked desert camp
summary: Official Fadi al-Qassem says all residents have left al-Hol camp, which long housed relatives of alleged ISIL members.
